card.name: Last digit before a percent sign
card.fires_on: A digit inside a multi-digit number right before the % sign, such as the 5 in 35% or the 0 in 50%. It also fires on a single digit after a symbol like ≥ when % follows.

modes.description: The last digit of a two-digit number that is immediately followed by %, in effect sizes or ranges.
